guide.overview: A Warrior Champion with both explosive damage and staying power, Batman Knightfight tears through groups with **AoE physical damage** and **crit-based cooldown reduction**. If his Ultimate defeats no enemies, he strikes again immediately. The first time he would take lethal damage, his HP is briefly locked at 1.
